entry.content:
Welcome to my new Pelican blog! This is a test post to verify that the reStructuredText parsing, template rendering, and build pipeline are working correctly.

Why Pelican?

Pelican is a static site generator written in Python that doesn't require database lookups or heavy server-side execution when readers visit the site.
